research_question: Can a PCA-anchored, harm-constrained rank-16 int8 residual sidecar produce a stable out-of-fold Recall@10 advantage over the storage-matched PCA sidecar without changing the frozen IVF-PQ index, query representation, payload bytes, alpha, or correction depth?
scope: post-V9 method development on the historically opened oracle_design role only; V9 outcomes motivated the stability question but no V9 packet, arrays, metrics, identities, qrels rows, or artifacts may be read by this pipeline

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: the single frozen V10 configuration did or did not show a stable five-fold OOF advantage over PCA on oracle_design

parent_evidence.v9_algorithm_finding: RARS-v8 minus PCA Recall@10 was +0.001452885 with a confidence interval crossing zero and all five registered algorithm gates failed
parent_evidence.v9_use_policy: disclose the result and use it only to motivate stability constraints; never read V9 files or use V9 outcomes for parameter, checkpoint, threshold, or method selection

data_policy.dataset: deterministic qrels-preserving 1M MS MARCO passage development corpus

cross_validation.fold_rule: inherit exact rars_v3_fold_v1 SHA-256 fold assignment

data_policy.challenger_semantics: candidate absent from positive qrels; unjudged and never called an explicit non-relevant
permitted_input_roots: oracle_design frozen V3 candidate and role-label bundle
RARS-v6 diagnostic packet for lineage verification

pair_mining.promotion: known positive outside Base Top-10 but inside Top-40 versus unjudged Top-10 challenger, only when same-route exact score prefers the positive
pair_mining.protection: known positive inside Base Top-10 versus unjudged ranks 11-26, only when same-route exact score prefers the positive

objective.distillation: query-role-balanced smooth-L1 error between projected and exact pairwise residual margins
objective.cutoff: smooth positive-margin barrier on base margin plus alpha times projected residual margin
objective.tail_harm: query-equal CVaR of squared positive shortfall relative to PCA-corrected pair margins
objective.pca_anchor: projector-distance-equivalent overlap penalty against the PCA subspace

optimization.optimizer: deterministic full-batch Riemannian gradient descent on the Stiefel manifold
optimization.checkpoint_selection: final accepted step only; no metric-based checkpoint selection

optimizer_audit.pair_subset: first 512 pairs in deterministic V8 mining order after fold-specific query filtering
record: central finite-difference derivative after QR retraction

comparators.storage_matched_pca: rank16 int8 PCA sidecar with identical alpha, Top-B, scale, code, and scorer
comparators.pca_rank16_fp32_coefficient_ceiling: non-deployable same-basis same-Top-B diagnostic that isolates scalar int8 coefficient-quantization headroom; never used to tune V10
comparators.frozen_v8: historical result disclosed but not rerun as a selection comparator
comparators.same_candidate_exact: non-deployable exact scoring ceiling on the same candidates
comparators.m48_rebuild: V9 limitation result disclosed in narrative, never read by V10 development

avq_scalar_headroom_diagnostic.purpose: determine whether replacing uniform per-dimension int8 scales with a ScaNN-inspired score-aware 256-codeword scalar codebook has enough theoretical Recall@10 headroom to justify a separate protocol
avq_scalar_headroom_diagnostic.comparison: rank16 PCA FP32 coefficients minus identical-basis rank16 PCA int8 scalar coefficients under the same Base candidates, alpha, Top-B, scorer, and query role
avq_scalar_headroom_diagnostic.future_code_budget_if_authorized: 16 one-byte scalar-codebook indices per document plus globally shared rank16 basis and 16x256 float32 codewords; disclose global codebook overhead separately

inference.primary_endpoint: paired known-positive Recall@10 difference: V10 minus PCA
inference.seed_offsets: none; every registered comparison records its explicit bootstrap and randomization seed

prohibited_actions: reading any V9 packet, V9 output directory, V9 notebook output, or V9 per-query array from the V10 evaluator
calling unjudged challengers explicit non-relevant documents
changing any method, objective, optimization, inference, or gate value after the first V10 metric is observed
selecting among multiple ranks, weights, angles, CVaR fractions, steps, seeds, or checkpoints
modifying the frozen V8 core or V8/V9 closure artifacts
stacking PCA and learned per-document codes
training, selecting, or evaluating a ScaNN-inspired codebook in the V10 run; V10 only measures the preregistered PCA-FP32 versus PCA-int8 scalar headroom
using V9 to authorize or reject a V10 configuration
claiming success when any stability or PCA-superiority gate fails
